sizeScript.method: esbuild --bundle --minify, gzip level 9, platform node. line is createRenderer([line]) from packages/core/src. all is packages/core/src/all.ts.

bench.method: esbuild --bundle --minify, platform browser, NODE_ENV=production, gzip level 9, brotli quality 11. Same config for every entry. ChartKit minimal is createRenderer of one gallery chart from packages/core/src. ChartKit /all is one bundle for every core chart and every theme, without the validator. Rival entries import only the pinned module that chart needs. ECharts uses echarts/core plus one series, its components, and CanvasRenderer. A library is not tree-shakeable when its native entries' gzip sizes differ by at most 512 bytes. That full-package size is recorded once. Those per-type cells are labeled not tree-shakeable and do not repeat the number. A package with one native type keeps the number on the cell. Commercial packages are measured when npm installs them without a license key. Google Charts is not an npm package. Gallery aliases that repair to one chart type are listed on that type and are not a second bundle.
